name: Proximity: covered skin 2-14 mm from the metal while following (user 2026-10-15: pass at 14 mm, aim for 10)
judge: full-exo/score_design.py BAND_HI=14 (exact posed skin, 30 fps clips)

name: Aim: the same at 2-10 mm (the 1 cm rule)
No part enters the body, any frame of any clip
Follows the arm (frames tracked, not held at a limit)
Overhead works (Raise overhead clip score) (14 mm band)
Shoulder-chain DOF from the scapula base to the arm, counted kinematically (cap 4; the user's scapula handler is a separate part)
No interference between parts that move relative to each other
judge: judge/part_contact.py (geometry only; exact depth, inside = winding number)

name: Every custom part is one valid closed solid
judge: judge/part_validity.py (OCC BRepCheck on the exported STEP)

name: Strength: SF >= 1.5 at 25 N.m worst direction; deflection and fatigue bounded
judge: independent FEA (CalculiX) - only the in-house hex8 study exists (pipeline/conformal/thin_study)

name: Base rides the scapula on the user's scapula handler: worst GH misalignment from base slip over the bone (proposed)

name: Interface pressure under ISO/TS 15066 body-region limits
